sources.title: Mirai president describes current Ogaki data-center operations
sources.publisher: Impress / Cloud Watch; firsthand interview with Mirai Communication Network
sources.attribution: Impress / Cloud Watch; firsthand interview with Mirai Communication Network
sources.summary: President Yoshihito Ito describes current colocation, hosting and network services in Ogaki. Hosting is the main growth business; customers include government bodies, universities and private companies. He reports groundwater-assisted cooling efficiency work and says the facilities are not designed for high-density GPU workloads. September 29 is the interview publication date; the interview day is undisclosed. The testimony concerns existing Ogaki operations and does not establish a new opening or individual-building utilization.
